operation_findings.observation: CreateNewScene and Read are public native-interface wrappers. OnSceneSave(string) and OnSaveAsPrefab() are protected-internal virtual callbacks with a single ret body.
operation_findings.gap: No general scene-save command established. Creating a native scene does not establish editor-document creation, save-as, dirty tracking or persistent scene serialization.

operation_findings.observation: The only declared method names containing undo are internal registration/deregistration helpers; call edges are List.Contains and Add/Remove.
operation_findings.gap: No undo transaction push, rollback, undo or redo invocation established. Registration is not an editor undo API.

operation_findings.observation: The only declared method names containing import are navmesh-prefab loaders. CheckResourceModifications forwards to IUtil.
operation_findings.gap: No texture/mesh/rig import, GUID allocation, settings serialization or Resource Browser database-write route established.

operation_findings.observation: No declared method name contains publish. ExecuteCommandLineCommand and command completion forward to IUtil. Prior manual publisher reports establish a UI workflow only.
operation_findings.gap: Command registration/arguments, job completion/failure, headless viability and autonomous MCP invocation remain unproved.

operation_findings.observation: Terrain height/node/read queries and dynamic snow texture binding exist. Scene also exposes a flora instance-count query.
operation_findings.gap: No terrain height-patch/paint-brush/resize or foliage paint operation established in inspected Scene/IScene declarations. Texture binding is not terrain authoring. Historical combined terrain-export crash does not isolate one failing call or establish editor behavior.

operation_findings.observation: Prefab load/save, face-group enable/merge/separate and path/point addition wrappers exist. Attached dynamic-navmesh operations also occur in GameEntity/WeakGameEntity.
operation_findings.gap: Arbitrary static editor topology creation, terrain-derived rebuild, persistent face painting, spline-handle editing and road/river mesh regeneration are not established by these declarations.

operation_findings.observation: Material has 56 declared methods; CreateCopy, resource lookup, shader/texture/name setters call IMaterial. No save/import/publish method in this class.
operation_findings.gap: Runtime copies/mutations do not establish persistent Assets records, preserved GUIDs, resource-database saves or published material changes.

operation_findings.observation: Mesh creation, triangle/corner edits, edit-data locking and morph-time setter exist and delegate to IMesh.
operation_findings.gap: Runtime geometry edits and the EditData name do not establish FBX import, LOD authoring, durable mesh resources, editor undo or publication.

operation_findings.observation: Skeleton model creation, bone-frame mutation, animation-channel parameter and cloth reset wrappers exist.
operation_findings.gap: No rig creation, skin-weight authoring, animation-track serialization, cloth constraint editor or face/body morph-resource persistence established.

operation_findings.observation: ConstructMainThreadJob creates and enqueues managed jobs; RunJobs dequeues and invokes them; WaitJobs queries queue emptiness. GetMainThreadId delegates to IUtil.
operation_findings.gap: Enqueueing is not proof of an active editor engine-thread scheduler. Callers and pumping in empty editor, scene switches, modal work and teardown require separate tracing and live proof.
